document.title: Skill steps split into substeps with done lines; rare branches move to references
document.summary: `SKILL.md` splits Workflow steps 2, 3, and 4 into lettered substeps with done lines. Refresh, Export, stacked requests, and the local CLI move to files under `references/` behind pointers.
document.why: The Workflow steps grew long because each feature landed in the step that owns its tool call, and steps repeated rules from their sections ([PR #175](source:s1)). Material only some runs need sat in the file every run reads ([PR #175](source:s1)).

sources.label: PR #175
sources.title: Skill steps split into substeps with done lines; rare branches move to references
sources.gist: Restructure the skill text with no behavior change: lettered substeps, grouping criteria in step 3, branch-only material in references. Eval results across variants.

groups.title: Workflow steps as lettered substeps
groups.why: Long steps mixed many actions and checked grouping one step late ([PR #175](source:s1)).
groups.summary: Each lettered substep in steps 2, 3, and 4 names one action and ends on its own done line, and the grouping done list moves from step 4 into step 3b.

focus.caption: The grouping criteria that step 4 used to check now close step 3b, where the groups are made.

notes.body: The version check stays in `SKILL.md` because every run prints a version line in step 2b.
The old step 4 done list now sits in 3b and in 4a to 4g; this line keeps only the ref checks.

groups.title: Branch-only material moves to references
groups.why: Refresh, Export, stacks, and a local CLI are needed only on some runs, so they leave the file every run reads ([PR #175](source:s1)).
groups.summary: Pointers in `SKILL.md` name the trigger for each new file under `references/`, which runs the CLI as `<cli>`; the hunks at new lines 23 and 121 also hold substep text from the first group.

attention.note: Refresh, Export, stacks, and the local CLI now load only when their pointer fires. No eval case runs those paths ([PR #175](source:s1)), so a pointer the agent skips goes unnoticed. Decide whether reading the pointer wording is enough proof.

notes.body: The `<executable> --version` swap that sat in step 2 now lives in `references/local-cli.md`; step 2c compares that line with the pin.

fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/SKILL.md: Pointers replace the Refresh, Export, stack, and local CLI text.
fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/references/refre: Former Refresh section, with `<cli>`, 4a to 4c substeps, and pointers to stacks and export.
fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/references/stack: Stacked request rules from step 1 and step 2.
fileNotes.skills-next/comprehende/references/power: Points at `references/refresh.md` in place of the Refresh section.
fileNotes.scripts/eval/skill.test.ts: Checks the `SKILL.md` pointer to `local-cli.md` and its `--version` sentence.

groups.title: Generated skill copy
groups.why: `pnpm sync:skill` copies the skill source into `.agents/skills/` for agents that work in this repo.
groups.summary: Each file under `.agents/skills/comprehende/` repeats its `skills-next/comprehende/` source byte for byte, so the reader can skip this group.

commits.subject: Skill review fixes: stacked and exported refresh read their references
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Refresh step 2 reads stacks.md on a stack, and step 5 reads export.md when the review was exported. The <cli> definition no longer lists its forms, the substep rule is general, and Grouping rules stop pointing every run at refresh.md. skill.test.ts guards the SKILL.md pointer to local-cli.md.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

commits.subject: Skill: Workflow steps as lettered substeps, branch-only material in references
commits.author: Máté Molnár
commits.body:
Steps 2, 3, and 4 split into lettered substeps, each one action with its own done line that points at its reference section. Grouping done-criteria move from step 4 to step 3b. Refresh, Export, stacked requests, and the local-executable CLI move to references/ behind pointers that name their trigger; reference files use a <cli> placeholder because sync and eval rewrite the pin only in SKILL.md. The version check stays inline in step 2c.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
